summary: Stores raw geometry made with TouchDesigner's SOP modeler and protects that modeled data from being unlocked or accidentally destroyed.

key_params.name: num_points
key_params.note: Diagnostic count of points in the stored geometry.

key_params.name: num_prims
key_params.note: Diagnostic count of primitives in the stored geometry.

common_gotchas: Model SOP is not the normal target for procedural construction.
It cannot be unlocked because that protects modeler data.
Use procedural SOPs when repeatable generation is required.
key_concepts: Model SOP stores raw geometry produced by the SOP Modeler.
It cannot be unlocked, protecting modeled data from accidental destruction.
Any SOP can be locked and edited with the modeler; Model SOP is the protected storage result.
The official page has no normal user parameter page; documented values are Info CHOP diagnostics.
